description: Runs one INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE / DDL statement on a connection the owner opened to agent writes (agentWrites in database/connections.json). Production-like connections are always refused; DROP, TRUNCATE, schema changes (CREATE / ALTER) and DELETE / UPDATE without WHERE are refused unless the owner's policy allows. dryRun (default true) runs the write in a transaction, reports rows affected and rolls back; pass dryRun:false to commit. Prefer setting up test data through the API under test when it can.

connection.description: Name or id; optional when there is one

dryRun.description: Default true: run, report, roll back

params.description: Object for :name placeholders, or array for $1 / ? / @p1

name: db_execute
title: Run a SQL write
